name: Gmr Airports
about: GMR Airports Infrastructure Ltd. is a leading airport infrastructure developer, focusing on building, operating, and managing airports in India and internationally. The company manages major airports such as Delhi and Hyderabad and is expanding its presence globally with projects in Cebu (Philippines) and Greece. In addition to core airport operations, GMR Airports develops commercial real estate and aviation-related services. Its offerings include terminal management, cargo handling, and duty-free retail. With a focus on enhancing passenger experience and operational efficiency, GMR Airports Infrastructure Ltd. plays a vital role in shaping the future of global airport infrastructure development.
